person_note: The Goodreads quotations are mostly dialogue, maxims, or isolated third-person sentences and therefore do not independently establish narrative person. Web evidence resolves the structure: an authorized third-person opening, interior analysis showing the same omniscient narrator, and multiple whole-book structural descriptions all agree that a nonparticipating narrator moves among characters and plot lines. No source indicates a sustained first- or second-person section, so the controlling narration is THIRD; the main limitation is that the authorized primary excerpt covers only the opening.
